body.label: Effect
body.html: Your Familiar alerts you to danger. Gain +1 Defense against the next Action that targets you before your next turn.

surges.html: Increase the Defense bonus from this Action by 1.
Reduce the Full Manifestation dice threshold by 1. This Surge may be used only once.

rider.title: FAMILIAR — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 3 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 1 additional Mana to fully manifest your Familiar.
